name: 咔咔雀
evolution: 咔咔羽毛 → 咔咔雀 Lv.18 → 咔咔鸟 Lv.36
description: 仿照洛克号的帆进化出了大尾巴，曾经尝试练习滑翔，大尾巴让它们能够短暂浮空，也可以用来吓唬和拍打敌人。
descriptionEn: Evolved a large tail modeled after the sail of the Roco ship; it once tried to practice gliding, and the big tail lets them briefly float and can be used to scare and swat enemies.

skills.name: 防御
skills.descriptionEn: Reduces damage by 70%, when responding to attacks.

skills.name: 复写
skills.description: 每回合随机变成自己未携带的技能，且该技能能耗-2。
skills.descriptionEn: Each turn randomly becomes a skill not equipped, and that skill's energy cost -2.

skills.name: 猛烈撞击
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 羽化加速
skills.description: 自己获得全技能威力+20，迅捷。

skills.name: 疾风刺
skills.description: 造成物伤，1连击，若先于敌方攻击，改为3连击。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 1-hit combo; if acting before the enemy, becomes 3-hit combo.

skills.name: 快速移动
skills.description: 自己获得速度+80，应对防御：改为速度+160。
skills.descriptionEn: Gains Speed +80; when responding to defense: becomes Speed +160.

skills.name: 回旋风暴
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成魔法伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage to the enemy.

skills.name: 羽刃
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：回合结束使敌方紧急脱离。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; when responding to status: at end of turn forces enemy to retreat.

skills.name: 追打
skills.description: 造成魔伤，1连击，应对状态：本技能变为3连击。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals magic damage, 1-hit combo; when responding to status: becomes 3-hit combo.
